description: Defines a PartialEmployee DTO class within the LDAP plugin, used to hold partial employee information such as employee ID and work email, with methods to create an instance from an Employee object.

classes.name: PartialEmployee
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for partial employee data, including employee ID and work email, with methods to set and retrieve these fields, as well as a factory method to create an instance from an Employee entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID, which may be null.

methods.name: setEmployeeId
methods.description: Sets the employee ID and returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: getWorkEmail
methods.description: Returns the work email, which may be null.

methods.name: setWorkEmail
methods.description: Sets the work email and returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: createFromEmployee
methods.description: Creates a new PartialEmployee instance populated with data from an Employee entity.
